    # Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
    dfs = []

        df['earliest_cr_line'] = pd.to_numeric(df['earliest_cr_line'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source DataFrames vertically (union all rows)
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Since the target schema is just ['earliest_cr_line'] and examples show integer values,
    # no further transformation is needed besides ensuring the type.

    # Drop rows where earliest_cr_line is null (if any)
    combined_df = combined_df.dropna(subset=['earliest_cr_line'])

    # Convert to int (from Int64) for final output
    combined_df['earliest_cr_line'] = combined_df['earliest_cr_line'].astype(int)

    # Write the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_54/target_multisource_cot.csv"
